methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: On-demand platform training via ed2go distributes access to workforce upskilling in underserved Southwest Virginia, but the pre-packaged nature suggests shallow adoption rather than deep capability building—classic platform-mediated distribution without localized expertise development.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals grassroots capability building rather than top-down platform delivery, suggesting potential for distributed deep learning if the programs emphasize hands-on technical skills over surface-level familiarity.

signals.title: Norfolk Southern deploys AI system to catch wheel defects before they break - The Business Journals
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Southern's deployment of industrial AI for predictive maintenance demonstrates sectoral depth in Hampton Roads' logistics/transportation cluster, but concentration within a single major employer reinforces rather than distributes technical capability across the regional workforce.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA intensifies the region's defense-AI nexus, concentrating both capital and specialized talent in the metro corridor while widening the gap with regions lacking defense-industrial anchors.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Growing AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce without corresponding signals of deep training infrastructure or distributed capability-building suggests anxiety about displacement rather than empowerment—a hallmark of shallow adoption creating economic uncertainty rather than opportunity.
